description: Enterprise policy for Marksmith Governance Monitor. Push via Intune/GPO/managed storage. This extension is NOT distributed via the Chrome Web Store — deploy it as an unpacked/force-installed extension via managed policy. Governance is always-on for this extension (it has no other purpose).

orgName.description: Organization name shown to employees in the persistent monitoring badge.

collectorUrl.description: Base URL of the governance collector — a Marksmith instance on a shared/always-on machine, or a future hosted service. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:47821 if unset.

userId.description: Identity to attribute events to (typically populated from SSO/device enrollment).

userEmail.description: Employee work email, if the org attributes by email instead of userId.

policyUrl.description: Link to the organization's AI-usage / monitoring policy.

captureMode.description: Determines how the extension handles DLP hits. 'masked' sends redacted context and masked matches for zero-knowledge review. 'raw' captures the exact unmasked text of the message for full forensic ground truth.
